content.title: Life-Choice Type Journey | Written Trigger, Spatial Words and Eye Lockup
content.summary: An adult planner writes three action words that become a station route and fold into one original life statement. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult identity and one initial writing action establish authorship of the word system. + Each new exact short word follows one visible action and becomes one distinct environmental structure. + The character crosses or touches every word structure while retaining one route direction and stable identity. + Previous words remain traceable as later chapters increase scale or density. + The final close view recombines all semantic stages into one exact original sentence and a stable personal reaction.
quick_start.recommended_input: Lock one original adult urban planner with cropped black hair, a rust coat and a brass notebook at a quiet blue-hour station. She walks through that passage as the exact word "CROSS" becomes amber floor bars leading toward the far platform. Finish on her steady eye line while all structures fold into the readable original statement "MAKE THE NEXT MAP" and stop.
required_anchors: One clearly adult identity and one initial writing action establish authorship of the word system.
Each new exact short word follows one visible action and becomes one distinct environmental structure.
Previous words remain traceable as later chapters increase scale or density.
The final close view recombines all semantic stages into one exact original sentence and a stable personal reaction.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult planner writes three action words that become a station route and fold into one original life statement. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 先用成年人物的一次书写动作提出主题，再让原创短词依次变成圆环、道路、台阶和环境标记；人物持续穿过这些文字结构，终局回到同一身份的眼神或静止主标。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult identity and one initial writing action establish authorship of the word system.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult identity and one initial writing action establish authorship of the word system."

invariants.rule: Each new exact short word follows one visible action and becomes one distinct environmental structure.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Each new exact short word follows one visible action and becomes one distinct environmental structure."

invariants.rule: The character crosses or touches every word structure while retaining one route direction and stable identity.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "The character crosses or touches every word structure while retaining one route direction and stable identity."

invariants.rule: Previous words remain traceable as later chapters increase scale or density.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Previous words remain traceable as later chapters increase scale or density."

invariants.rule: The final close view recombines all semantic stages into one exact original sentence and a stable personal reaction.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final close view recombines all semantic stages into one exact original sentence and a stable personal reaction."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
